cases.label: l3-c3-midrun-escape
cases.source: test-data/l3-orekit/vt-16/l3-orekit-c3-midrun-escape.json: Orekit's own event state (position_m, velocityAfter_mps); Δt = t − m of Orekit's segment 1 (k ≥ 1)

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 5 (Proposed, awaiting owner approval; ML-TASK-018 part D3) §6.8 "Extended O-1 check", §12 O-12
tolerance.formula: Pass when |t(χ̂) − Δt| ≤ ε_t,gen(Δt) + δt_α,hyp(Δt), t(χ̂) the universal time equation evaluated in high precision at the engine χ̂ with α, σ₀, r₀ formed in high precision from the exact binary64 input (§6.1 O-1 route (1), extended to E > 0 by revision 5 §6.8). ε_t,gen of §6.8 (revision 4); δt_α,hyp = 5u κ_E(r₀) D(x)/n_h, κ_E(r₀) = 1 + 4|a|/r₀, D(X) = e|sinh F₀|[(cosh X − 1) + X sinh X/2] + (sinh X − X) + (e cosh F₀/2)[(sinh X − X) + X(cosh X − 1)] (revision 5). No margin factor (as the elliptic O-1 threshold).
tolerance.assertion: gated: asserted only after the owner signs revision 5 (§15)
